name: messagebae
description: A small macOS app for Facebook Messenger chats, with keyboard shortcuts, mute and a menu bar icon. Unofficial.

scripts.dist: node scripts/bump.js && APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE=messagebae electron-builder --mac && sh scripts/staple.sh

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Messenger uses the microphone for calls and voice messages.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Messenger uses the camera for video calls.

author: Jonathan Chin <messageBae@jchin.au>
